Name: NextDNS
Author: Rogier Dijkman - rogier.dijkman@azurehacking.com
Description:
The NextDNS solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest DNS logs and analytics aggregates from NextDNS into Microsoft Sentinel.

 **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

 This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some dependencies may be in Preview state or may incur ingestion costs:

 - [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework](https://aka.ms/Sentinel-CCP_Platform)
Analytic Rules: Analytic Rules/NextDNS - Newly observed domain burst.yaml
Analytic Rules/NextDNS - Malicious category blocked surge.yaml
Analytic Rules/NextDNS - Analytics blocked ratio spike by profile.yaml
Analytic Rules/NextDNS - Analytics malicious reason concentration.yaml
